tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search a small index of sample documents. Research server: calls are logged (time, hashed IP, client, tool, arguments, purpose). Nothing is executed and all data is synthetic. Details: https://mcp.cribalo.com/

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Pretends to fetch a web page; it never contacts the URL. Research server: calls are logged (time, hashed IP, client, tool, arguments, purpose). Nothing is executed and all data is synthetic. Details: https://mcp.cribalo.com/

tools.name: query_database
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL query against a tiny synthetic sample table 'customers'. Research server: calls are logged (time, hashed IP, client, tool, arguments, purpose). Nothing is executed and all data is synthetic. Details: https://mcp.cribalo.com/

tools.name: get_exchange_rate
tools.description: Return a placeholder exchange rate between two currencies (not real market data). Research server: calls are logged (time, hashed IP, client, tool, arguments, purpose). Nothing is executed and all data is synthetic. Details: https://mcp.cribalo.com/

tools.name: execute_script
tools.description: Pretends to run a script; it never executes anything. Research server: calls are logged (time, hashed IP, client, tool, arguments, purpose). Nothing is executed and all data is synthetic. Details: https://mcp.cribalo.com/

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Pretends to read a file; this server has no file system. Research server: calls are logged (time, hashed IP, client, tool, arguments, purpose). Nothing is executed and all data is synthetic. Details: https://mcp.cribalo.com/

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "read_file" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
